verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions idempotency keys, deduplication of duplicate triggers, or exactly-once step semantics. Concurrency keys, the CANCEL_QUEUED_EXCEPT_NEWEST/OLDEST queue strategies, retries and durability are related controls, but none of them is documented as preventing duplicate execution or side effects. A durable workflow engine could plausibly ship this capability, so the axis applies and the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a backend developer, idempotency keys and exactly-once step semantics stop duplicate triggers from double-charging or double-sending
